items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: I played with Gilbert. Gilbert Young. ... I played with Gilbert Young.

ctx.x: I can't just recall. But anyway, I played with Gilbert. Gilbert Young. You know Gilbert Young? I played with Gilbert Young. I imagine... I couldn't tell you exactly how many I have right off the reel, you know? But after you leave, I imagine it's different people I could recall that I can't just now. But anyway, I...
I was wondering, it seems like somebody told me maybe your brother or somebody thought you'd made some records with Joe Robichaux. Do you remember? I did.
